title: Brief Canadian trip with Miff Mole

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Also it says here that you had a brief trip to Canada with Miff Mole's band, August 1943.
Uh huh. Well that was while I was rehearsing for Carmen Jones, a little gig that I got together and took Miff Mole up there with me.
Yeah, it was my band. Miff Mole and Ernie Caceres I had and I forget who else, but Miff Mole was one of the names. We just went up there and did a one night gig.
What was Miff doing during that time?
Gigging around, recording. He would stop in the Metropole all the time, come up and sit in with us.
And Ernie was with the Glen Miller band.
Ernie Caceres, yeah. And then we're out there free lancing, doing a lot of recordings.
Then you eventually went into studio work.
